# R Reference {#sec-glossary}

```{r table_func, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)

make_glossary_table <- function(df) {

  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      Function = paste0("<code>", Function, "</code>"),
      Example = paste0("<code>", Example, "</code>"),

      Practical = sub(
        "\\[([^]]+)\\]\\(([^)]+)\\)",
        '<a href="\\2">\\1</a>',
        Practical
      ),

      Help = sub(
        "\\[([^]]+)\\]\\(([^)]+)\\)",
        '<a href="\\2" target="_blank">\\1</a>',
        Help
      )
    )

  DT::datatable(
    df,
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(
      paging = FALSE,
      searching = FALSE,
      info = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```


```{r read_function_csv, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
funcs <- read_tsv("R_glossary.tsv")
funcs <- funcs |>
  arrange(Function) |>
  mutate(
    Practical = sub("\\.qmd#", ".html#", Practical)
  )
```


## Basic R functions {#sec-basic_functions_glos}

```{r basic_functions_glos, echo=FALSE}
subsec <- funcs |>
  filter(Type == 'Basic') |>
  select(!Type)
subsec |>
  make_glossary_table()
```
